# prime-treeselect

prime-rs: TreeSelect component (PrimeNG port)

[Live demo](https://anton-avramchuk.github.io/prime-rs/treeselect) · [API docs](https://docs.rs/prime-treeselect) · [Port notes](https://github.com/anton-avramchuk/prime-rs/blob/HEAD/docs/treeselect.md)

TreeSelect — port of `p-treeselect` from PrimeNG 21.1.10.

A field for selecting a tree node (or nodes): a label with comma-separated captions or chips, a clear icon, a dropdown button and
a panel inside the root with a ready-made `prime_tree::Tree`. The value is a two-way signal of the keys of selected nodes
(`RwSignal<Vec<String>>`; in `Single` mode — 0 or 1 key). Selection modes, filter and messages are passed to `Tree`.

```rust
use leptos::prelude::*;
use prime_tree::TreeNode;
use prime_treeselect::TreeSelect;

let options = vec![TreeNode::new("0").label("Documents").children(vec![TreeNode::new("0-0").label("Work")])];
let value = RwSignal::new(vec!["0-0".to_owned()]);
let html = Owner::new().with(|| view! { <TreeSelect options=options value=value placeholder="Select" /> }.to_html());
assert!(html.contains("p-treeselect-label") && html.contains("Work") && !html.contains("p-treeselect-overlay"));
```

## Installation

```toml
[dependencies]
prime-treeselect = "0.1"
prime-theme = { version = "0.1", features = ["treeselect"] }
```

The component renders PrimeNG classes; its styles come from `prime-theme` (the Aura theme), one feature per component.
For server rendering enable the `ssr` feature in the server build and `hydrate` in the browser build.
Setting up an application (theme, SSR and hydration): https://anton-avramchuk.github.io/prime-rs/install
